email_body:
Dear Monsana team,

I'm applying for the Sales & Marketing role. Your mission of improving patient access to clinical trials through AI resonates with me, and I'd love to help bring Monsana to new customers.

My background combines digital marketing with a technical edge. As a freelance SEO and AI search specialist, I've built and optimized websites, created content, and used AI tools daily to automate prospecting, research, and reporting. At Episto, I handle SEO content and CMS management for client sites, and at Knowledge Experts I supported digital workplace projects for large organizations like ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo. This mix of sales support, content creation, and operational execution fits what you need.

I'm comfortable working independently, learning quickly, and wearing multiple hats. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to Monsana's growth.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Monsana team,

I'm writing to apply for the Sales & Marketing role. Monsana's work at the intersection of healthcare and AI—helping doctors identify eligible patients faster—is exactly the kind of mission I want to support. I'd like to bring my mix of digital marketing, technical skills, and hands-on execution to your growing team.

In my freelance work, I build and optimize websites for traditional and AI-powered search, write content that ranks, and use AI tools daily to automate research, content creation, and audits. For example, I designed and launched baverok.com myself, including a hand-coded landing page and a free site-check enquiry flow. For mirook.com, I implemented structured data and ran technical SEO audits that measurably improved search health. These projects taught me how to create sales and marketing materials—presentations, case studies, LinkedIn content—and how to use AI to work more efficiently.

At Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research, and SEO content for client websites, managing CMS updates in WordPress and tracking results with Semrush, Ahrefs, and Google Analytics. I also work on Shopify stores, maintaining product catalogues and publishing blog content. Earlier, at Knowledge Experts, I supported digital workplace projects for large organizations like ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo, which gave me experience with project management, reporting, and meeting preparation.

I'm comfortable approaching potential customers, leading demos, and preparing proposals—skills I've developed through client work and freelance projects. I enjoy variety and am happy to roll up my sleeves on operational tasks. I use AI tools wherever they add value, from prospecting to follow-up, and I'm eager to apply that mindset to sales and marketing at Monsana.

I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your growth. Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

• Technical skills: Python automation, HTML/CSS/JavaScript, and experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) for prospecting and lead follow-up.
